objections: Redaction only transforms detected spans; this column has no span labels and the host plus health search terms survive (e.g. apteekki.example/haku?q=<antidepressant>, ajanvaraus.terveyspalvelu.example/varaa?palvelu=..., liitto.example, srk.example), exposing special-category browsing per keyed user, which the scenario excludes and the threat model targets.
Keeping the host in clear also defeats the keyed tokenisation chosen for proxy_logs.domain and the suppression of proxy_logs.category.

No listed utility task needs the URL: exfiltration, phishing-click and insider rules use domain, bytes, src_ip and time, so removal loses little while redaction leaves residual secrets if any query parameter is missed.
